chapter.verse: Tua hi a, Khris tawh a thokik na hih uhleh Pasian' taklama tu Khris a omna mun, tunglam thute zonin nei un.
Leitunga om thute hilo, tunglama thute ah na lungsim tusak un.
A hang pen note a si khin na hi uh a, na nuntakna uh Pasian' sungah Khris tawh a kiseelkhawm ahi hi.
Na nuntakna uh ahi Khris hong kilat ciangin note zong minphatna sungah amah tawh na kilangkhawm ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin nulepa tatkhialhna, thanghuai gamtatna, cilesa lunggulhna, duhgawh deihgawhna leh milim biakna ahi huaihamna, cihte-a kipan na leitung pumpi nate uh na sisak un.
Hih thute huhau-in (thumanglo mite' tungah) Pasian' hehna hong tung ding hi.
Note zong tuate tawh na nuntak lai-un tua bangin na gamta uh hi.
Tu-in ahihleh hehna, lungsona, thusia geelna, daisakna, thanghuai kam zatna, cihte khempeuh na paihkhiat ding uh ahi hi.
Mi lui leh a gamtatna teng a suahkhia khin na hih uh kithei-in khatlekhat zuau kigen kei un.
Piangsakpa' limlemel zui-in theihna cingtaak tawh a kibawlhoihkik ahi mi thak a silh khinsa na hi uh hi.
Tua sungah Greek leh Jew, vun-at leh vun-atloh, khuata mi leh Scythia mi, sila leh tualmi suakta, cih bang om lo hi; Khris pen na khempeuh a huamkimpa ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' teeltuam, a siangtho, itte ngaihte na hihna uh tawh a thukhual lungtang, migitna, kiniamkhiatna, lungnemna leh lungduaina, cihte puan bangin silh un.
Khatlekhat kithuaksiam unla, khat in khat' tungah mawhsak ding a neih leh khatlekhat na kimaisak un. Topa in note hong maisak khin ahih mah bangin note in zong na maisak un.
A phadeuhin a cingtaak kipumkhatna ah hong hualkhawm ahi itna, puan bangin silh un.
Khris' nopna lemna in na lungsim uh hong uk ta hen. Tua' adingin note pumpi khat sungah hong kisamkhia ahi hi. Lungdamin om un.

Note' sungah Khris' thu a dimletin na teengsak unla pilna a namkim tawh khatlekhat kihilhcianin kitaaibawlin Pasian' tungah hehpih phatna lungsim tawh phatna late, biakpiak late leh kha late na sa un.
Kampau tawh ahi-a gamtat tawh ahi zongin na hih peuhpeuh uh a vekin Topa Jesu' min tawh na hih unla ama' tungtawnin Pa Pasian' tungah lungdam na ko un.
Zite aw, Topa' sungah a kilawm thu ahih mah bangin na pasalte uh' kiangah na niamlut un.
Pasalte aw, na zite uh it unla, amau' tungah gamhtat kei un.
Tate aw, na khempeuh ah na nulehpa' thu na mang un. Tua in Topa lungkimsak hi.
Pate aw, na tate uh phinbawl kei un. Lungkiat thanemna-in neikha ding uh hi.
Silate aw, muhna beka sem, mi a pum mai-ette bang hilo-in Pasian kihtakna tawh lungsim siangtakin na khempeuh ah na leitung tote uh' thu na mang un.
Bangbang na sem uh zongin mi' ading ahilo, Topa' ading bangin lungsim pia-in sem un.
Pahtakman dingin Topa' kiangpan gamh ngah ding cih thei un. Note pen Khris Topa' na a sem na hi uh hi.
Khialhna bawlte ahihleh a bawl uh khialhna hangin thuakkik ding uh hi. Guptuam paihtuam cih bang om lo hi.
